prompts.task: Treat ./service as the project root. Create ./service/.observe/ and copy the canonical ./service/otel-audit.json fixture to ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json. No downstream selection, instrumentation, or verification overlays exist. The user explicitly accepts source-only dashboard use of the exact current metrics http.server.request.duration, http.server.active_requests, http.server.request.size, http.server.response.size, checkout.orders.processed, and checkout.payment.errors for this run. Generate dashboard Terraform for ./service so every output is written under ./service/.observe/ and ./service/.observe/terraform/. Generate the dashboard Terraform (group + dashboard + per-panel chart resources), variables.tf, terraform.tfvars.example, the .observe/dashboards.md report, and the .observe/dashboards.preview.json Observer sidecar. Keep the absent checkout.queue.depth metric out of charts and record its instrumentation prerequisite. Run the bundled dashboard validator with the canonical audit and one exact SOURCE-METRIC source-only item approval per charted metric. Do not create missing overlays, read or fall back to an audit Markdown report, call any network, or run terraform.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service/.observe for the resulting files when present, especially ./service/.observe/terraform/dashboards.tf, ./service/.observe/terraform/variables.tf, ./service/.observe/dashboards.md, and ./service/.observe/dashboards.preview.json.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Reads canonical .observe/otel-audit.json and groups its explicitly accepted source-backed checkout RED metrics into panels: a latency/duration time-series panel from http.server.request.duration, an error-rate panel from checkout.payment.errors or the route-filtered error.type view of http.server.request.duration, and a throughput/rate panel; saturation or KPI single-value panels are reasonable additions. It does not read or create an audit Markdown report, and it keeps absent checkout.queue.depth out of charts.

Writes three-level dashboard Terraform to .observe/terraform/dashboards.tf: a signalfx_dashboard_group, at least one signalfx_dashboard, and one signalfx_*_chart resource per panel referenced from the dashboard's chart { chart_id = ... } blocks.
Places each chart on the real 12-column Splunk grid via the chart blocks (column 0-11, width 1-12, row >= 0, height >= 1) so no panel overflows 12 columns.

Chart program_text reuses the data('<metric>', filter=filter('service.name', ...)).<agg>().publish(...) SignalFlow pattern with a visualization aggregation (percentile for latency, sum for rate/errors) and carries NO detect()/when()/threshold() alerting tail.
Writes variables.tf with realm, api_token marked sensitive = true, and service_name, plus a terraform.tfvars.example, and never hard-codes a real token.

Writes .observe/dashboards.preview.json as valid JSON with schemaVersion 1 and a groups -> dashboards -> charts tree whose chartType values come from the time_series|single_value|list|heatmap|text|table vocabulary and whose layout matches the Terraform grid placement.
Writes a .observe/dashboards.md report explaining the panel classification rationale and hands off to terraform apply or the dashboard publish skill without performing any network call.
